decisions.reason: It survived its launch year and fits the firm's sensor-platform logic, so its results likely met a minimally satisfactory aspiration level even if it remains somewhat vulnerable as a niche sensing module.

As a 3.0 replacement for an existing voltage-measurement module, it builds on proven demand and likely exceeds aspiration levels relative to comparable products, giving management little reason to withdraw it.

The CAN bus interface complements the firm's automation and embedded customer base well, and continued presence after launch suggests satisfactory performance with enough strategic fit to justify keeping it.

The CO2 sensor module remained visible beyond launch and serves clear measurement use cases within the modular ecosystem, so management would likely judge it as meeting aspirations and retain it unless resources became unusually tight.
